# Ball side after a goal and dispenser effects (spec 02 §6, §7.1).
config dispenser=on
start official first=away
expect release away
expect last ball_released side=away
sensor home_goal              # away scores, home conceded
expect release home
expect next_ball home
sensor away_goal
expect release away
plus home
plus home
plus home
plus home
expect score 5:1
expect winner home
expect release none           # no ball after the winning goal

config after_goal_ball=scoring
start official first=home
expect release home
sensor home_goal              # away scores and gets the ball
expect release away
sensor home_goal
expect release away

config after_goal_ball=alternate
start official                # "Start new game" parks the running game …
start official first=home     # … "Start now" kicks off
sensor away_goal
expect release away
sensor away_goal
expect release home
sensor home_goal
expect release away

config dispenser=off after_goal_ball=conceding
start official
start official
expect release none
expect last game_started
sensor home_goal
expect release none
expect next_ball home         # still tracked for resuming
